why: Ceilings for the six visit moments, roughly three to four times the number recorded in docs/PERF.md, and looser where the recorded number is small enough for noise to dominate (a 73 ms warm run is mostly scheduler jitter). This file gates a regression that matters, not a busy afternoon: wall-clock time on a shared machine is noisy, so a tight ceiling would be re-run until green, which teaches the gate to be ignored. Raising one is allowed, but only with a fresh --record row and a sentence in docs/PERF.md that says what got slower and why the new number is acceptable.
